title: Why Do We Glorify Suffering? The Spiritual Truth (1981-09-11)
description:
Exhausted by the rat race and modern life's pressures? Discover the psychosomatic root of chronic stress and how spontaneous awakening brings balance.

This public program explores the evolution of human seeking and the spontaneous nature of spiritual awakening. Shri Mataji clarifies misconceptions about suffering, false gurus, and extreme lifestyles, culminating in a profound explanation of how modern stress damages the subtle energy system.

Key Topics:
• 🧠 Evolution of seeking - how humanity shifted from conquering others to material possessions, and finally to true spiritual awareness
• ⚡ The myth of suffering - why we don't need to suffer for spiritual growth and how true awakening is a spontaneous, living process
• ⚠️ The dangers of false gurus - understanding why enlightenment cannot be purchased, organized, or achieved through physical force
• 🌸 Mooladhara (Root Chakra) - the center of innocence and why purity is essential for the safe awakening of your Kundalini energy
• 🔬 The psychosomatic roots of disease - how the "rat race" overworks the spleen and creates severe imbalances in the subtle system

“Whether you talk of the material God or about the abstract God, whether you talk about the flower or the honey, you just talk. You have to become the bee to get the honey.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How the rat race and modern stress damage your energy chakras?
• Why you can never pay money for true spiritual enlightenment?
• Is Kundalini energy related to sexuality or innocence?

Have you ever felt exhausted by the 'rat race' of modern life? How do you find balance and protect your inner peace when things get too busy?
